title: Ecclesiastes Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Ecclesiastes 7: a good name and the house of mourning, the rebuke of the wise, patience over pride, and one man found among a thousand.

questions.text: What does the first verse say a good name is better than?
questions.explanation: The verse says a good name is better than fine perfume, and the day of death better than the day of one's birth.

questions.text: Where is it better to go than to the house of feasting?
questions.explanation: The verse says it is better to go to the house of mourning than to the house of feasting, for that is the end of all men.

questions.text: What is it better to hear than the song of fools?
questions.explanation: The verse says it is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

questions.text: What is the laughter of the fool compared to?
questions.explanation: The verse says that as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool.

answers.text: A dream that comes in the night
The wind blowing over the waters
The crackling of thorns under a pot
A cord broken in the middle

questions.text: Who is better than the proud in spirit, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says better is the end of a thing than its beginning, and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

questions.text: Where does anger rest, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says not to be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

answers.text: In the heart of the proud
In the gates of the city

questions.text: What is the excellency of knowledge, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense, but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

answers.text: That knowledge makes a man rich
That knowledge wins the king's favor
That wisdom preserves the life of him who has it

questions.text: What should you do in the day of prosperity, and in the day of adversity?
questions.explanation: The verse says: in the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider, for God has made the one side by side with the other.

questions.text: What does this chapter say about a righteous man on earth?
questions.explanation: The verse says surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn't sin.

answers.text: He is one among a thousand
There is none who does good and doesn't sin
He will live long in his righteousness
He is a defense to his city

questions.text: What did the Preacher say he found among a thousand?
questions.explanation: He says: 'I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.'
